I have authored over 50 journal articles, as well as a range of other output. Here, I categorize all this into two broad areas of my work (global governance & international political economy; and global health & social protection), and flag my favourite articles with an emoji (🥰). 

The most up-to-date list of publications is available on [my Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=WSKvdv4AAAAJ).

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const links = document.querySelectorAll("#pub-filters a");
  function apply(cat) {
    links.forEach(l => l.classList.toggle("on", l.dataset.cat === cat));
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub").forEach(p => {
      const show = cat === "all" || p.dataset.cats.split(" ").includes(cat);
      p.classList.toggle("hidden", !show);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".pub-list").forEach(list => {
      list.querySelectorAll(".pub-year").forEach(h => {
        let n = h.nextElementSibling, any = false;
        while (n && !n.classList.contains("pub-year")) { if (!n.classList.contains("hidden")) any = true; n = n.nextElementSibling; }
        h.style.display = any ? "" : "none";
      });
    });
    if (history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null, "", cat === "all" ? location.pathname : "#" + cat);
  }
  links.forEach(l => l.addEventListener("click", e => { e.preventDefault(); apply(l.dataset.cat); }));
  const h = location.hash.replace("#", "");
  if (["gov","health","fav"].includes(h)) apply(h);
});
</script>
